extraction.Name: Susan Jane Carter formerly Wright
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded by Harold Oldham June 28, 1920
extraction.Buyer: Harold A. Oldham for $1.00 and other valuable consideration; Oldham agrees to sell the land for $7000, $700 in cash, $700 by Susan to Oldham, $2500 of the purchase price in the form of one certain Franklin automobile, balance $3100 on or before July 1, 1920
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739694 issued; Lots 3 and 4 and S/2 of NW/4, section 2, township 99, north of range 78; receipt signed by allottee April 3, 1920; land contract dated April 15, 1920 between Susan Jane Fielder (formerly Susan Jane Wright) and Harold A. Oldham; deed dated July 28, 1920; allottee also referred to as Susan Jane Fielder and Susan Jane Carter (divorced)
